description: This file defines the SalesforceRoutingTraceService class, which provides static methods for tracing and logging various Salesforce CRM routing operations, including account resolution, owner lookups, validation, and GraphQL-specific steps. It interacts with an external CrmRoutingTraceService to record trace steps.

classes.name: SalesforceRoutingTraceService
classes.description: A static class providing trace methods for Salesforce CRM routing operations, utilizing AsyncLocalStorage for context management.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Private static method to add a trace step via CrmRoutingTraceService.

methods.name: searchingByWebsiteValue
methods.description: Logs a trace when searching for an account by website value.

methods.name: accountFoundByWebsite
methods.description: Logs a trace when an account is found by website match.

methods.name: searchingByContactEmailDomain
methods.description: Logs a trace when searching for account via contacts with the same email domain.

methods.name: accountSelectedByMostContacts
methods.description: Logs a trace when an account is selected based on having the most contacts.

methods.name: noAccountFound
methods.description: Logs a trace when no account could be found.

methods.name: lookupFieldQuery
methods.description: Logs a trace for lookup field query execution.

methods.name: userQueryFromLookupField
methods.description: Logs a trace for user query from lookup field result.

methods.name: contactOwnerLookup
methods.description: Logs a trace for contact owner lookup.

methods.name: leadOwnerLookup
methods.description: Logs a trace for lead owner lookup.

methods.name: accountOwnerLookup
methods.description: Logs a trace for account owner lookup.

methods.name: ownerValidated
methods.description: Logs a trace when owner validation confirms team membership.

methods.name: ownerLookupSkipped
methods.description: Logs a trace when owner lookup is skipped.

methods.name: contactOwnerCheckSkipped
methods.description: Logs a trace when contact owner check is skipped.

methods.name: graphqlQueryInitiated
methods.description: Logs a trace when a GraphQL query is initiated for account resolution.

methods.name: graphqlExistingContactFound
methods.description: Logs a trace when an existing contact's account is used.

methods.name: graphqlAccountFoundByWebsite
methods.description: Logs a trace when an account is found by website match via GraphQL.

methods.name: graphqlSearchingByContactDomain
methods.description: Logs a trace when searching related contacts by email domain via GraphQL.

methods.name: graphqlDominantAccountSelected
methods.description: Logs a trace when a dominant account is selected from related contacts via GraphQL.

methods.name: graphqlNoAccountFound
methods.description: Logs a trace when no account is found via GraphQL.

methods.name: fieldRulesValidated
methods.description: Logs a trace for field rules validation results.

methods.name: fieldRuleFilteredRecord
methods.description: Logs a trace when a record is filtered out by field rules.

methods.name: fieldRuleEvaluated
methods.description: Logs a trace for field rule evaluation details.

methods.name: allRecordsFilteredByFieldRules
methods.description: Logs a trace when all records are filtered out by field rules in SOQL path.
